_note: Phase 10 whole-car assembly: sizes of the stand-in parts that `suspkin assembly` draws around the hardpoints (A-arm tubes, rod ends, damper, anti-roll bar, steering rack, wheels). The upright, rocker and pushrod bracket come from data/parts.json (Phase 9), so they match the parts that were stress-checked. All sizes in mm. Change a number and re-run `suspkin assembly` to get a new results/car_assembly.json for the Fusion CarAssembly script.

tubes._note: Outside diameter and wall. 19.05 x 1.65 is 3/4 in x 0.065 in 4130 tube, the sizes checked in Phase 8 (data/load_cases.json).

rod_end._note: Simple stand-in: a short cylinder (the eye) centred on the pivot, along its bolt.

clevis._note: The wishbone's outer end straddles the upright's ball joint boss (bearing axis fore-aft): two plates either side of the boss.

damper._note: About the size of a typical FSAE damper (e.g. 200 mm eye to eye). The coil spring is drawn as a stack of rings.

arb._note: Blade arm from ARP to ARA; the bar turns in two bearing blocks, bearing_inset mm inboard of each arm.

steering_rack._note: Front only. The housing sits on the line between the two inner tie rod ends; the rack rods run out to them.

wheel._note: 10 in rim (127 mm bead radius), 7 in wide tyre. The tyre's outer radius is the loaded radius, WC to CP. The centre (hub and spokes) sits at the hub face (packaging.hub_face_axial_mm in the hardpoints file).

frame._note: Phase 10 step 2: an FSAE-style tube space frame built around the suspension pickups (see solver/suspkin/frame.py). Points are LEFT side, car coordinates (mm, x forward from the front axle line, z up from the ground); the right side is mirrored. Every A-arm pickup (UAF, UAA, LAF, LAA) sits on a short tab just outboard of a frame node (pickup_tab_mm), so every wishbone pivots at a joint of the frame and the rails stay clear of the tie rods and rack. The hoop heights and positions are made-up but FSAE-like; this is a visual and packaging model, not a rules-checked frame.

hoop._note: Front and main hoop (1 in x 0.095 in)

primary._note: Side impact, bulkhead, hoop braces, rails

rocker_mount._note: The rocker and damper hang off a top cross tube this far behind the rocker pivot, at the damper's chassis-end height; a strut from there down to the upper wishbone rail carries the rocker pivot tab. The top side rail runs at top_rail_y, outboard of the rocker and damper, so nothing crosses them.

pickup_tab_mm._note: [inboard, down] from each wishbone pickup to its frame node; the pickup sits on a tab between them.
